episodes.title: The Legendary Hit Man
episodes.summary: Sakamoto enjoys a quiet life in retirement with his family. But one day, an old colleague demands he return to the assassin world - or face consequences.

episodes.title: Vs. Son Hee and Bacho
episodes.summary: While out on an errand, Sakamoto and Shin encounter Lu Shaotang, the daughter of a mafia boss, who's on the run and targeted by twin assassins.

episodes.title: Welcome to Sugar Park
episodes.summary: After learning of the huge bounty on Sakamoto's head, the crew tries to enjoy a family outing at the amusement park while fending off assassins.

episodes.title: Hard-Boiled
episodes.summary: With the poison-wielding hitman taken out, the Sakamotos head to their next attraction, where they're ambushed by Dondenkai Ltd's ultimate assassin duo.

episodes.title: Source of Strength
episodes.summary: Sakamoto goes all out in a fierce one-on-one duel with Boiled. Meanwhile, ORDER members are tasked with handling a serial case targeting assassins.

episodes.title: Heisuke Mashimo
episodes.summary: Hoping to win the million-yen prize, Team Sakamoto enters the shopping district's survival tournament and teams up with a completely clueless sniper.

episodes.title: Jurassic Bastard
episodes.summary: While manning the store alone, Lu gets kidnapped by a mysterious group. Sakamoto and Shin pursue her but are halted by an invisible assassin.

episodes.title: Sakamoto's vs. the Lab
episodes.summary: To rescue Lu, Sakamoto and Shin infiltrate a top-secret lab seized by assassins. Meanwhile, in the prison cell, Lu meets someone from Shin's childhood.

episodes.title: All Aboard
episodes.summary: In the depths of the Lab, Shin and Heisuke join forces to take down the invisible assailant, while Sakamoto engages in an intense battle against Kashima.

episodes.title: Bathhouse Roughhouse
episodes.summary: Exhausted from their battle, the crew heads to a local bathhouse but finds it too dangerous to relax. Later, a mysterious man arrives in search of Lu.

episodes.title: Casino Battle
episodes.summary: The crew faces Wutang in a high-stakes casino showdown to learn who issued Sakamoto's bounty. Meanwhile, X sends a group of vicious assassins their way.

episodes.title: Overload
episodes.summary: As Sakamoto gathers intel on the assassins targeting him, ORDER begins hunting the death row inmates. Later, Shin and Lu face a deadly assault.

episodes.title: Just Desserts
episodes.summary: Saw's attacks push Shin and Lu to awaken new abilities, turning the tables on the deadly killer. Meanwhile, Dump ambushes Osaragi at a temple.

episodes.title: Strong Assault
episodes.summary: The battles rage on even as the crew gets treated by Granny Miya! Minimalist threatens Aoi at the store while Heisuke clashes with Apart at Tokyo Tower.

episodes.title: Round and Round the Tower
episodes.summary: Despite his inability to lose weight, Sakamoto faces off against Apart in a fierce showdown. Later, X reveals his dangerous plans for the assassin world.

episodes.title: Slice Slice Dance
episodes.summary: While X and Gaku invade the JAA, a lone ORDER assassin stands in their way. Amid the chaos, Sakamoto discovers the shocking truth about X's identity.

episodes.title: Have a nice flight
episodes.summary: Sakamoto decides to infiltrate his alma mater to get more intel on X. But first, he must conquer the sky-high requirements of the JCC entrance exam.

episodes.title: Kanaguri
episodes.summary: It's every assassin for themselves as the exam takes to the skies. While Sakamoto impresses fellow candidate Akira, Shin takes on the germaphobe Mafuyu.

episodes.title: Exam: Stage Three
episodes.summary: Stage Three of the JCC exams begins as a trio of special applicants joins the fray. Toramaru, a devoted Sakamoto fan, immediately clashes with Shin.

episodes.title: Mutual Fans
episodes.summary: Sakamoto discovers Akira's ties to an old friend. While Shin and Toramaru vie over their favorite assassin, X's secret plans throw the exam into chaos.

episodes.title: Hard Mode
episodes.summary: Shin teams up with Mafuyu, Toramaru and Kaji to take down a berserk Shinaya. Can these ragtag new allies work together to defeat their rampaging foe?

episodes.title: Each One's Mission
episodes.summary: With the entrance exam behind them, Sakamoto and Shin can now continue with their original objective: infiltrating the JCC and obtaining clues on X!
